description: - Bidding Phase: Unassigned tasks bid on resource minimizing cost + price, incrementing
resource price by regret gap plus epsilon and displacing prior occupant.
- Epsilon Scaling: Decrease epsilon geometrically across successive auction phases.
- Fallback: Revert to LAPJV/shortest augmenting path if the matrix is non-square, cost
magnitudes are extreme, or auction rows remain unmatched.
Python uses -1 for unmatched indices and reports inputs for which no bid or augmenting path can be selected.
